info.title: Telnyx API

get.description: Lists RCS agents owned by the authenticated organization, optionally filtered by brand.

parameters.description: Only return agents belonging to this brand.
parameters.name: brand_id

200.description: RCS agents owned by the organization.

post.description: Creates an editable RCS agent draft under a brand. The `Idempotency-Key` is scoped to the authenticated organization. Reusing the key with the same request returns the original agent, while reusing it with a different request returns a conflict.

201.description: The agent draft was created or replayed from the idempotency record.

Idempotent-Replayed.description: Present with value `true` when a successful response was replayed for the supplied idempotency key.

get.description: Retrieves an RCS agent, section statuses, test devices, carrier approvals, and provider capabilities.

patch.description: Updates one or more fields on an agent while its status is `CREATED`. Submitted agents cannot be changed through this endpoint.

get.description: Lists carrier approval records for an RCS agent. The provider may expose per-carrier, hub-level, or bot-level approval status.

200.description: Carrier approval records for the agent.

post.description: Adds the campaign and testing configuration, then starts asynchronous carrier launch. Agent basics must already be submitted. Repeating a launch that is already in progress returns the current agent without creating new work.
post.summary: Submit an RCS agent for launch

post.description: Starts asynchronous provider provisioning and submits the agent's basic configuration. The brand must be `VERIFIED`. Repeating this request for an in-progress agent returns its current state without creating new work.

202.description: The basic agent submission was accepted.

get.description: Lists test devices attached to an RCS agent.

200.description: Test devices attached to the agent.

post.description: Adds an RCS-capable test number after provider agent creation. Repeating the request for a number already attached to the agent returns the existing test device.

201.description: The test device was added or already existed.

post.summary: Add an RCS agent test device

delete.description: Removes a test device from an RCS agent and its provider registration.
delete.summary: Remove an RCS agent test device
